_comment: V3 idiom A/B blind reads. Singles: one image per task, no source, no sibling views; description + strict JSON {question_answered, action, blockers, confidence}. Pairs: both candidate images of one slot+repo in one task, pre-registered A/B order (prereg.md section 4). Structured extraction follows the V0 reads.json convention.

protocol.blind: singles: no source, no sibling views, no expected answer; pairs: both candidates of one slot+repo only
protocol.matrix_re_render: kv2-matrix rows corrected post-first-read to production-first includers (see map-idiom-ab.md protocol note); the three matrix singles above are the corrected renders at manifest 63f6e0da
protocol.pair_render_provenance: All 9 pairs (including the 3 KV2 pairs) were dispatched after the matrix row correction and compare the corrected matrix renders bound by manifest_sha256; the 3 pre-correction matrix singles were replaced, not retained.
protocol.kv1_tiebreakers: finding_id is unique in all three scans; the implemented path/span tiebreakers after finding_id are unreachable, so the ordering matches the documented key.

post_prereg_corrections: KV3 ranking key gained startup demotion (entry_kind main/script) to match the locked spec; demote_score = startup + no_loop, ascending. KV3 scale domain = non-demoted max; demoted rows shown off-scale with full values.

kv2-matrix row selection changed from raw top-12 out-degree to production-first includers (top 8 production out-degree + production dependents of the top 3 columns, non-production fill only to reach 12) after the first cJSON render hid every production dependent of cJSON.h. All three matrices were re-rendered and re-read; no other candidate changed.

singles.desc: KEY VIEW · KV1 · TMUX, 'Where do I look first?'. pairs.why: Both pose the same question and rank format.c:6052 first, but the cards' per-card code snippets (highlighted lines matching each path:line) verify the target and fill in the brief's truncated rationales and unexplained directory-aggregation blurb, cutting ambiguity without slowing the top-line answer.

Bars state the ranked answer in text with the widest blast radius (tmux.h, 160 dependents, 74% of scanned files) so the do-not-touch action is immediate; the matrix buries the same totals in a dense dot grid's bottom row.

Bars name format_replace at format.c:6052 with 67x median / top 1% and confidence badges so the action is stated immediately; near-equal treemap tiles make the top pick ambiguous and omit file:line and uncertainty flags.
The brief delivers the identical ranked path:line answer with less visual noise; code snippets in the cards are redundant context for an action-framed question and add scanning ambiguity.

Bars name the top-risk file with full path and quantified context (src/quantity/mod.rs, 12 dependents, 6.0x median); the matrix's identical top total of 12 sits under a column labelled only 'mod.rs' with three ambiguous same-named columns, forcing guesswork.

Bars name the answer with file:line, disambiguate the three identical 'main' labels via paths, and show 30x median as evidence; the treemap gives bare names and numbers with no location and three indistinguishable 'main' tiles.

Both answer with the same top pick (cJSON_Utils.c:807 apply_patch), but the brief is a compact scannable list where the path:line action is visible at a glance, while cards pad each item with code excerpts that slow reading without changing the next step.

Bars name the top-risk file (cJSON.h, 5 dependents) and the no-edit action at a glance; the matrix forces legend decoding and surfaces larger totals (unity_config.h 22) that are vendored test scaffolding, inviting a wrong action.

Bars give an unambiguous ranked list with file:line anchors and cost metrics so 'profile cJSON_Delete at cJSON.c:253 first' is read directly; near-equal treemap tiles make ranking harder and omit location anchors.

decision_rule: Pair winner = 1, tie = 0.5; a candidate wins a slot at >= 2.0 of 3; split => single-read question-match, action specificity, then mean confidence; locked-parenthetical conflict => default to the V2 lock pending founder ratification.
